run.executedVia: Playwright runner, no browser and no writes. ServiceNow read over cnit, Salesforce over the sf CLI. Each case compares the transform output held in Salesforce against the source record it was built from.

case.title: The control catalogue is reconciled by nothing

steps.text: Read active controls from ServiceNow and the mirrored catalogue from Salesforce.

expected: Active controls in ServiceNow and CAF_Control_Catalog__c are set-for-set identical by sys_id.
Every mirrored row for an active control carries Active__c = true.
